dialogues.speaker: Sonnet
dialogues.text: When did you get here? How long has it been?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I can't say for sure... But it feels like it's been forever...

dialogues.speaker: Sonnet
dialogues.text: I see... Are you feeling alright? You look a little unwell.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I can hold out a while longer...
